note: What a server sends as a player's client drops out. The header carries zero.

fields.name: champion
fields.note: The player's champion, matched against the owner of each champion the client knows.

bits.name: toEnemies
bits.note: Set to show the notice only to the other side; clear to show it only to the player's own side. A client with no champion of its own shows it only where this is clear.

revisions.note: A client shows a chat notice naming the player in their side's colour, and nothing where player names no champion it knows, names its own champion, or the match is not under way.
